headline: Iran announces it has shot down an American MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz
summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said it has shot down an American MQ-9 unmanned aerial vehicle over the Strait of Hormuz. The claim has not been independently verified in the input.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil and LNG, so military incidents there matter for energy markets. The MQ-9 is a US surveillance and strike drone.
why_moved: A reported shoot-down of a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz raises perceived risk to shipping through a key energy chokepoint. Oil prices typically respond to such supply-route risk.
